summary: Backend-only unit/behavioural testing of the VPS-delete spam fix (2026-02 vmi3508080). Extended /app/backend/tests/test_vps_delete_idempotent.js from 2 checks to 6 comprehensive tests covering: source patterns, regex spelling coverage (American 'canceled' + British 'cancelled'), behavioural exercise of deleteVPSinstance against a mocked smart-proxy Contabo throwing the exact prod error, throttle-math for the scheduler's 6h/10-retry alert window, guard on the 'VPS Auto-Deleted' admin post for alreadyGone=true, and verification that all 5 deleteVPSinstance call sites in _index.js gate on .success/.error (so alreadyGone success shape is safe). ALL 6 TESTS PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is well-targeted: isAlreadyGone helper (L1255-1258) + outer catch (L1366-1368) BOTH match /already been cancel(l)?ed|already cancel(l)?ed|instance is already cancel(l)?ed/i, so both American and British spellings are caught.

Scheduler Phase 2 (L36108-36160) correctly gates the 'Auto-Deleted' admin post on !deleteResult.alreadyGone AND writes a differentiated cancelReason ('auto_renewal_failed_already_gone' vs 'auto_renewal_failed'), so the DB record moves to CANCELLED on the very next successful tick regardless of whether Contabo actually did anything — preventing the scheduler from re-picking the record.

Throttle math is correct: 1st attempt always alerts, then only every ≥6h, hard-stop after 10 retries. Verified 11th attempt at any age → no alert. Crash-path (L36145-36159) mirrors the same throttle — good.

All 5 deleteVPSinstance call sites in _index.js gate on cancelResult.success (or .error), so the new alreadyGone success shape is backwards-compatible with the 3 EARLY-CANCEL paths (L35941 auto-renew-off, L35992 wallet-fail, L36031 pre-emptive) and the profile-page path at L19982.
Minor nit (non-blocking): _index.js is 48,983 lines. Violates the file-size guideline (>700 lines). Not related to this fix but worth flagging for future modularisation.
seed_data_creation: None — tests are fully mocked (Contabo smart-proxy + Mongo collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_vps_delete_idempotent.js is now a full regression suite (T1 source patterns, T2 regex spellings, T3 behavioural deleteVPSinstance against smart-proxy mock, T4 6h/10-retry throttle math, T5 alreadyGone guard on admin post, T6 all 5 call sites safe). Run via `/opt/node22/bin/node /app/backend/tests/test_vps_delete_idempotent.js` — exits 0 on success. Note: vm-instance-setup.js uses `require('./vps-provider').buildSmartProxy()` (NOT direct './providers/contabo') — stub './vps-provider' when mocking Contabo for this module.
rca of the issue: Root cause: Contabo's 400 'Cannot cancel instance as it has already been canceled.' was not in the isAlreadyGone regex (only 404 + 'Entry Instances not found' were). Scheduler kept picking up PENDING_CANCELLATION records → retried every ~30s → each retry emitted an admin alert (43× in one day for vmi3508080). Fix expands the regex to catch both American and British spellings, marks the record DELETED on the idempotent path, and throttles admin alerts to ≤1/6h with hard-stop after 10 retries. Verified end-to-end behaviourally.
